## b25/REVIEW.md

# Separate review - The English Curriculum, build 25

- Time: Fri 6 Nov 2026 05:44 CST (from `date`)
- Build folder: /home/claude/mm/build-35/b25
- Zip: /home/claude/mm/build-35/b25/the-english-curriculum.zip, sha256 c5dddc16146add8c758da9e5ceca61eeb80da81e6b4c36998f6529ee37316164 (confirmed, starts c5dddc16146add8c)
- Compared: page code preview/index.html; full-page screenshots w1440-part01-21, w768-part01-31, w390-part01-33 (all looked at); the PDF "3.5.0 The English Curriculum.pdf" p1-p23 (rendered again at 90 and 200 dpi to read small text); the Word file (python-docx, every word, every paragraph's colour/bold/italic/indent); the Essay Code Template; tools/REQUIRED-CHECKS.txt eye rows (/home/claude/eng35/eye-rows-b25-full.txt, 143 rows); her rules (memory preferences.md, records/DECISIONS-LOG.md, records/DECISIONS-LOG-3-nov.md).
- Live comparison: not applicable (this page has no live version).
- No check output was used in place of looking. No file changed except this report.

## Words (Word file against the page, every word)
All words of the Word file are on the page, in order. The only differences, each excused by her written rule:
- UK spellings (characterised, practise, civilisation, recognise, tyrannise, colourful, memorising, organising): preferences "always UK English on the site" (13 Oct) and "USE BRITISH ENGLISH IN ALL INSTANCES" (26 Oct). Spellings inside quotations kept ("tyrannized" in the Montessori Method quotation) per her 26 Oct 15:57 words "do not change ... words inside a quotation".
- – and — shown as "-": preferences "short dashes only, everywhere on the site".
- Spaces round slashes removed ("me/choose", "Art/Drawing/Colouring", "language/bilingualism"): preferences "no spaces around a slash".
- "Table of Contents" shown as "Table of contents": preferences "the label above the contents list reads 'Table of contents'".
- Full-width bracket in the caption "Puzzle Words (aka Sight Words)": row AF002, her 6 Nov 00:19 agreement "the corrected full-width bracket".
- The dashes before attributions ("- Maria Montessori") are Word's list dashes, shown in the PDF (p9, p11, p12...).
- Word's duplicate text-box copies (Run/Hug, the Perugia caption) appear once on the page, as in the PDF.

## Faults (grouped by PDF page)

1. PDF p1/p3 - contents box and "Spoken Language" heading (code: index.html; w1440-part01, part02). The contents entry "Spoken Language" links to `id="toc-spoken"`, which is on the red list title "Spoken Language" above "Nomenclature Cards" (Word paragraph 171, PDF p4), not on the section heading "Spoken Language" (Word paragraph 124, PDF p3). That section heading stays green while the other five contents headings are red. Her rule 1 Nov 10:01: "Headings are all words in the table of contents ... On the page they need to be red" - the contents heading should be the PDF p3 one, in red.
2. PDF p2 - AMI list titles (w1440-part01, part02). "Spoken Language" (left column top), "Reading Stages" (right column top) and "Function of Words" are blue in the Word file (colour 0000FF, paragraphs 43, 78, 89) and in the PDF; the page shows them black (`<p data-space="29">Spoken Language</p>`, `<p data-space="20">Reading Stages</p>`, `<p data-gap="20">Function of Words</p>`). The PDF also has a blank space before "Keys to Literacy" and before "Function of Words" (as before "Writing Stages" and "Word Study"); the page has none (Sound Game to Keys to Literacy 27 px, smaller than the 32 px between list lines).
3. PDF p4 - attribution "- Maria Montessori, The 1946 London Lectures, p. 77." (w1440-part03). On the page it starts 95 px in (x 245), where every other attribution starts 48 px in (x 198). In the PDF it stands nearer the margin than the others (about 18 px in, against 45 px for the p5 attribution). No rule excuses it.
4. PDF p6 - beige line through text (w1440-part05, pixel rows 696-697). At 1440 the beige line after the Peace Table paragraph runs through the tops of the letters of "In the environments I have prepared, ..." (55 and 40 dark letter pixels on the two line rows). Not at 768 or 390.
5. PDF p10, p15, p18 - uneven gaps inside lists (1440). PDF p10 list: item 3 to item 4 is 28 px on the page, the others 33 (w1440-part09). PDF p15 Writing Stages second column: "Punctuation" to "Written Question Game" 26 px, others 32 (part14). PDF p18 Pink Language Materials: "Pink Booklet" - "Puzzle Words" - "Pink Phrase Cards" 32 px, the others 41 (part16). The PDF shows each list evenly spaced.
6. PDF p18 - "I use a mixture ... sequence of presentations:" list (w1440-part16/17). Word paragraphs 615-619 have a left indent of 1560 twips (about 104 px) and the PDF shows both columns indented (first column at about 1.3 in from the margin); the page starts the first column at the margin.
7. PDF p19 - Grammar image caption (w1440-part17; w390 sheet part28; w768 part25). The PDF puts "Maria Montessori, 1950, Perugia." under the image; the page puts it above the image at every width.
8. PDF p22 - Reading Analysis lettered lines a.-e. (w1440-part19). Word paragraphs 719-727 have a first-line indent of 720 twips (48 px) and the PDF shows "a." indented; the page puts "a." at the margin (x 150), text at 198.
9. PDF p2, p3, p4, p12, p15, p16, p17, p18, p20 - Word's columns at 768 (w768 parts 01-27). At 768 every two- and three-column list staircases: the second column starts only where the first column ends (e.g. "Reading Stages ... Continuation of Commands" starts beside the end of "Presentation and Storage of Work"; "Expansion of Oral Language", "Sorting Middle Sounds...", "Alphabet Books...", "make continuous strokes", "Preparation of the hand", "Crayons", "Upper and Lowercase Letters", "Writing Practice Series - The Alphabet", "3.10...", "Blue/Green Language Materials", "Action Cards 2", "Preposition"). The PDF has the columns side by side and level. Row D331: "the second column starts level with the first"; her 5 Nov 13:38 agreement ("a list that opens a column of Word's columns starts level with the other columns"). In the narrow columns the justified list lines also open wide word gaps ("Consonant      Blends", "Phonogram      Sandpaper").
10. PDF p3, p5, p10, p14, p16, p18, p19, p20, p21 - images beside text at 768 (w768 parts 03-27). At 768 the images the PDF puts beside the text on the right (Language area pair, Spoken Language shelf, Storytelling, Materials, I-Spy list image, Pinning, the reading-list grid, Object Box 1 pair, Grammar image, grammar-symbols box, Word Study cards) stand above or below the text, at the left or centred; the grammar-symbols box stands between "Noun" and "Article". The text beside them would be over 300 px wide. Her 5 Nov 09:16 agreement: "images beside text move under the text only when the text would be narrower than 200 px, at 641 px and wider".
11. PDF p19 - captions of the row "The Blue Series / The Green Series / Action Cards - Set 2 / Puzzle Words (aka Sight Words)" at 768 (w768-part25, zoomed). The swipe row shows the images with no captions above them; at 1440 and 390 the captions show.

Checked and excused (not faults): section headings "Writing - Abstract", "Writing - Concrete", "Reading", "Grammar" green in Word/PDF, red on the page - her 1 Nov 10:01 rule quoted in fault 1. Orange quotation text black on the page - preferences "orange text in Word always shows as regular black on the page". "Synonyms" in the label column though the PDF has no gap - her 5 Nov 04:37 agreement (label column "for lines made of a label and its text"). "Letter Bingo" titles on two lines at 768/390 - row B120. Two-column grids level at 1440 - her 5 Nov 13:38 agreement. Image sizes (e.g. the Writing Stages strip, 27 x 120 px, beside the columns as in PDF p15) - preferences "placement follows the source PDF roughly, sizes follow the template" (row A011).

## Words and her rules (not faults)
- Word against page, word by word: the only differences are her rules - UK spelling (characterised, civilisation(s), colourful, memorising, organising, recognise, tyrannise; practise/practising for the verb), "instills" -> "instils", the typo corrections "a quarter of an hour", "help the child learn", "an understanding of the perspective", "so the game", "so they unconsciously absorb", "a sense of how extensive", "with the titles" (twice) (her 27 Oct rule "correct all typos"); the full-width bracket in "Puzzle Words (aka Sight Words)" (AF002); "- " before every attribution (template quotation style); the Word title line replaced by the hero title "The English Curriculum"; spaces round slashes removed ("Art/Drawing/Colouring", "language/bilingualism"). "Run", "Hug" and "Maria Montessori, 1950, Perugia." are Word text-box captions, shown as captions, as in the PDF p19. Quoted words kept ("tyrannized", "being able write", "[,,,]").
- Colours: Word's green headings Spoken Language, Writing - Abstract, Writing - Concrete, Reading, Grammar (PDF p3, p9, p12, p17, p19) are red on the page: her rule 1 Nov 10:01 "Headings are all words in the table of contents. In the table the headings are black. On the page they need to be red" (DECISIONS-LOG.md line 96). Orange quotations are black italic (her rule). Pink/Blue/Green words in their colours (w1440-part16; w768-part10 "blue/pink/green").
- Spacing differences on the allowed list are not counted (tools/allowed/the-english-curriculum-space.txt, "owner 6 Nov 13:49 (b): template rule ..." and "phone layout follows the template (owner 21 Oct rule "no questions about phones")").

## Faults

### PDF p6-p7 (The Sound Game, First / Second / Third Stage)
1. The tab before the "I Spy" quotation inside the stage lines is lost. Word paragraphs 246, 251, 254 have "... the beginning sound: \t\t"I Spy with my little eye, something beginning with ...."", "... the ending sound. \t"I Spy ..." and "... the middle sound.\t"I Spy ..."; the PDF (p6 First stage, p7 Second and Third Stage) shows the quotation pushed right to a tab stop, a wide gap after "sound:" / "sound.". The page shows only a word space or two (code: `sound:<em>  "I Spy with my little eye, something <u>beginning</u> with ...."</em>`), so the quotation runs straight on: w1440-part06/07, w768-part07 ("always identifying the beginning sound: "I Spy with my little eye..."), w390-part11/12. No owner rule I found covers a tab inside a line (D130 covers only Word's tab before a quotation's first line). If she accepts it, it is one wording item; listed so she can say.

# Separate review - The English Curriculum (3.5.0), build 40, against build 39 (after the fast round)

- Time: Fri 6 Nov 2026 19:59-20:01 CST (from `date`), after "FAST-PASSED" in checks2 and "screenshots ready 19:58:51" in /home/claude/eng35/chain40.log (no "fast round stopped").
- Build folder: /home/claude/mm/build-35/b40
- Zip: /home/claude/mm/build-35/b40/the-english-curriculum.zip, sha256 44d8c51b3d5f0b704fc2475e1cde811111634ce727906829bc3c387839c79d32 (from `sha256sum`; matches "44d8c51b3d5f0b70" in checks2/SUMMARY.txt). 328 files.
- Compared: preview/ files against build 39's by sha256: only index.html differs. Its only change: two CSS lines added in the `@media (max-width:830px)` block (`.mm-dots span` 6x6 px round, colour --rule; `.mm-dots span.on` colour --ink). Before, the spans were sized only in the 640 block, so at 641-830 the dots box was there but empty. The dots script (`dots()`, runs when width is 830 or less) is unchanged. No words, images or other styles changed. Template: static.txt shows the template sha256 c0b6a91d... -> b8bfedec... and clone HEAD 21432c8 "Template: swipe dots drawn at 641-830" - the same change in the template.
- Screenshots: every part (w1440-part01..21, w768-part01..26, w390-part01..38) compared by pixel with build 39's; every changed part looked at by eye.
- NOT checked: PDF renders in /home/claude/eng35/review31/pdf/ not re-read (no words or images changed, so nothing new to compare with the PDF); widths 641-830 other than 768 by eye (no screenshots); swipe rows not swiped, so the lit dot moving was not seen; menu panels; links; full-size images and faces records; the long round (not run yet). No browser and no check script run. No file changed except this report.

## The intended change
- 1440: all 21 parts pixel-identical to build 39. As intended.
- 390: all 38 parts pixel-identical to build 39. As intended.
- 768: 14 parts changed (06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 18, 20, 21, 24), and in each the changed area is only a 6 px high strip of dots (28 strips, x 351-417), nothing else. Looked at by eye: each strip is a row of small round dots (first one dark, the rest light) about 8 px under a row of images that runs off the right edge (scrolls sideways); the number of dots matches the row's images (3 to 6). Rows: Reading area (6 dots), I-Spy rows (p7-p9), Sandpaper Letters (p10-p11), first sounds/letters (p12), Letter Bingo, blending (p12), p13, drawings and easels (p15), cutting/punch-pin (p16), Sandpaper/writing rows (p16, p18), Writing Stages scripts (p18), Blue/Green Series (p20), Bob Books (p21), Hole/Whole and Tide/Tied (p24).
- I also looked for any image row at 768 that touches the right edge without dots: every other block found is a single image beside text, a list image, a table image or the same row seen across a part boundary. No scrolling row without dots seen.
- Page height: no dot row added height (the dots box already had its place). w768-part26 is 798 px high (build 39: 797); its first 797 rows are identical and the extra row is beige footer background - the 1 px build 39 lost comes back (sub-pixel rounding). Not a fault.
- Observation, not counted: at 768 the dots are centred on the text column (centre about x 384), while most rows start to the right (x about 240-320), so the dots sit under the left half of the row rather than its middle. This is the same rule as on phones (`justify-content:center` on the dots box); on phones the rows fill the width so it does not show. For the owner to say if she wants them centred under the row.

PDF p7 shows a wide gap (tab) before ""I Spy with my little eye, something ending with ....". The tab span is in the code (b41 index.html), but at this width "sound." ends just before a 48 px tab stop, so the tab is only a few pixels wide and justification makes it look like a word space. First stage (64 px) and Third Stage (54 px) at 768, and all three at 1440 and 390, show the gap. No owner rule found that excuses it. It is Word's tab behaving as a tab (a Word tab also moves only to the next stop), so if she accepts it, it is one wording item.

## Faults

All seven are at 768 only (1440 and 390 are pixel-identical to b41 except the intended changes). Fault 1 comes from change (a). Faults 2-7 are in parts whose code is byte-identical to b41. Fault 2 is above the I Spy lines, and fault 1 adds no line (the paragraph has three lines in both builds), so the em spaces do not explain them: the same code was laid out differently in this capture. That looks like the page's layout being worked out before the images had their size (row D030, "including while images load late"). I could not find the cause without a browser. Each is a fault in what the build 42 screenshots show.

### PDF p6 (The Sound Game, First stage)
1. w768-part07 rows 536-584. PDF p6: "... always / identifying the *beginning* sound: [wide gap] "I Spy with my little eye, something *beginning* with ...."" with ordinary word spaces. Build 41 at 768: line 2 ended "... always identifying the *beginning* sound:" with word gaps of 5-7 px. Build 42: the em space makes "sound:" + gap too wide for line 2, so "sound:" goes down to start line 3. Line 2 ("increased by adding objects: 7, 9, 11, 13, 15 .... 35, always identifying the *beginning*") is justified with word gaps of 13-15 px (line 1 above: 8-9 px), so it shows wide, uneven gaps. Where a line breaks at the margin is not a fault, but the stretched line is new in b42 and the PDF does not have it. No owner rule found that excuses it. (The 6 Nov 23:37 test of the em space, in the decisions log, measured only the gaps, "768: 97/51/49".)

### PDF p3 (the Language area images beside "These are photos of the Language area in my classroom in Taipei ...")
2. w768-part02 rows 838-957. PDF p3 and b41: two images beside the text, about 160 x 120 and 208 x 120. b42: the same two images about 83 x 61 and 54 x 40, small in the middle of an empty area beside the text.

# Change list - The English Curriculum, build 42 (zip build-35/b42/the-english-curriculum.zip, sha256 ee6ba2247d286b73)
Written 6 Nov 21:2x, updated 7 Nov 07:3x from the decisions log (records/DECISIONS-LOG-3-nov.md). Earlier changes: builds 1-17 records/ENG-CHANGES-5-nov.md; builds 18-21 queues/the-english-curriculum-CHANGES.txt; builds 29 and 30 build-35/b29/changes.txt, build-35/b30/changes.txt.

## Page changes (pages/the-english-curriculum.py), builds 22-42
- Typos corrected (her 27 Oct rule "correct all typos on every page"): "so the game", "a quarter of an hour", "a sense of how extensive", "help the child learn", "an understanding of the perspective", "instils", "so they unconsciously absorb" (Word: "they unconsciously they"), "with the titles '" (Word: "title's", twice).
- Gaps: "apart" gaps on 4 lines where Word keeps its 6 pt after and the PDF shows a wider gap; no gap figure on the 2 headings straight after a beige line; the two "Follow ..." lines kept together (gap 20), as in the PDF.
- PDF page 2 list titles shown as ordinary lines, not headings (as in Word).
- Spoken Language shelf image moved after its beige line (as in the PDF).
- A full-width beige line (class mm-gl-full) for build 31 review fault 6.
- Review faults of builds 25, 31, 32, 34 fixed in the settings where they were the page's (REVIEW.md of each build).

- Word's tabs before the three mid-line "I Spy with my little eye ..." quotations (The Sound Game, First/Second/Third Stage) put back, each starting with one em space so the gap is never a few px (builds 41-42; b40 and b41 review fault 1).
- Faces: images 098 (boy cutting), 110 (girl drawing) and 109 (girl leaning on her hand) now blurred - her answers 7 Nov "Blur all three" and "yes"; round 2 sheet checked by a separate agent; pixel check after her answer passed, over every image the page uses unblurred too (build 42).
